visualCharacteristics.purpose: page-top banner with the page title (and optional intro) beside a photo or decorative graphic

contentPattern.structure: text cell (h1 title, optional intro, optional CTA) and picture cell, in either order, on one row or two

reuseGuidance: Use as the first block of a content page. Grey adds a tinted title box; Image gives the photo the larger share. For a promo box over a photo use hero-banner.
